rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for facing someone or dealing with a problem without necessarily implying an accusation.

example.english: We have to confront this difficult problem.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 min6 deoi3 ni1 go3 naan4 tai4

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for actively going head-to-head with someone in hostility or defiance.

example.english: You don't have to confront me all the time.
example.traditional: 你唔使成日同我對着幹。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 seng4 jat6 tung4 ngo5 deoi3 zoek6 gon3

rows.note: Use this when directly challenging someone about an issue or suspected wrongdoing.

example.english: They confront the official directly at the press conference.
example.traditional: 佢喺記者會上當面質問官員。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gei3 ze2 wui2 soeng6 dong1 min6 zat1 man6 gun1 jyun4
